description: The world's terrain, made by tools/terrain.py from world/terrain-inputs.json (O152): per 3.5 km square of the world model's grid the kind and the country, per square corner the height in metres, the main river's squares with their water level (source to mouth) and the estuary's squares; streams and the border line for the printed map; the fine rasters in world/terrain/. Do not edit: change the inputs and run the script.
